tiers.name: Lite
tiers.target_devices: budget tablets and low-end phones (Mali-G52 class)

tiers.name: Low
tiers.target_devices: mid-range phones and older integrated GPUs

tiers.name: Medium
tiers.target_devices: recent phones and integrated laptop GPUs

tiers.name: High
tiers.target_devices: desktops and laptops with discrete GPUs

tiers.name: VR
tiers.target_devices: standalone headsets and PC VR through WebXR
tiers.render_scale: 1.0× eye buffers with fixed or eye-tracked foveation

download_targets.status: provisional (Chris, 2026-10-20, S4-3; STAGES.md Stage 4 notes); fixed after the kart racer is measured on Low and Ultra
download_targets.basis: gzip level 9 of what a player's browser fetches on that tier (index.html, the code and the streamed files of one texture family); 1 KB = 1024 bytes, 1 MB = 1024 KB; build-time tool data for `cargo xtask check` and `cargo xtask publish`, never compiled into a game
download_targets.code_basis: wasm + js + html, the same on every tier; `3d` is any game whose look has the 3d style or that lists `models` (500 KB includes models and anim), `2d` every other game
download_targets.per_tier: each tier's `download_targets`: `boot_kb` the files the title waits for ([stream] boot), `total_kb` code plus everything the tier ever fetches, `texture_memory_mb` 75 percent of `max_texture_memory`

2d: Instanced sprite batches from one texture atlas per layer, a single render pass at reduced render scale, outlines and shading baked into sprites, no post chain beyond the final composite
Instanced sprite batches from one texture atlas per layer, a single render pass, outlines and shading baked into sprites
Instanced sprite batches plus a half-resolution post chain
Instanced sprite batches, normal-mapped 2D lighting in a light buffer, full-resolution post chain
Instanced sprite batches, high-resolution 2D light buffer, compute particles at full cap, full post chain
The 2D game sits on a lit table-top diorama or a large floating screen in a small 3D room, rendered in single-pass stereo with 4× MSAA
pseudo-3d: Pseudo-3D pass in a WGSL fragment or compute shader into a 320×180 target, nearest-neighbour upscale, shorter draw distance, no post
Pseudo-3D pass in a WGSL fragment or compute shader into a 320×180 target, nearest-neighbour upscale, minimal post
Pseudo-3D pass into a 320×180 target, post chain at target resolution
Pseudo-3D pass into a 480×270 target, longer draw distance, full post chain
Pseudo-3D pass into a 640×360 target, maximum draw distance and sprite count, full post chain
The pseudo-3D view plays on a curved virtual screen inside a 3D cockpit or arcade cabinet, rendered in single-pass stereo with 4× MSAA
3d: Forward pass with vertex or baked lighting, one directional light, blob shadows, tonemapping folded into the main pass, at reduced render scale with a smaller triangle and draw-call budget
Forward pass with vertex or baked lighting, one directional light, blob shadows, tonemapping folded into the main pass
Forward pass with instancing and CPU frustum culling, one shadow cascade, up to 8 point lights, HDR target with tonemapping
Clustered forward with compute light binning, two shadow cascades, image-based lighting, full HDR post chain, compute particles
GPU-driven: compute frustum and occlusion culling with indirect draws, four shadow cascades, compute particles, volumetric passes, optional temporal upscale

Single-pass stereo forward renderer with 4× MSAA instead of TAA, fixed or eye-tracked foveation, space-warp where available, baked lighting plus one shadowed light; PC VR headsets get High-tier limits
